prompts.prompt: Before pressing play, predict which character or performer your partner will enjoy most and explain why.
Choose one snack that matches tonight's program and give it a dramatic menu name.
Describe the kind of ending you hope for without guessing a specific plot event.
Name one setting from a past movie or show where you would gladly spend a weekend together.
At the first agreed break, compare the tiny background detail each of you noticed.
Choose one character decision so far and explain what you would have done differently.
Invent a harmless alternate title based only on the first fifteen minutes.
Share which scene would be hardest to explain to someone who had not watched the beginning.
Pick one costume, room, vehicle, or object from the screen that deserves its own story.
Make one prediction for the next act and decide when you will check whether it came true.
After a funny moment, rate how likely it is to become an inside joke between you.
Choose the line delivery or visual moment that has created the strongest mood so far.
Imagine adding yourselves as background characters and describe what each of you would be doing.
Name one part of the soundtrack or sound design that changed how a scene felt.
After the ending, share the moment that surprised you most without debating whose answer is better.
Choose one unanswered question you would ask the writer or director.
Decide whether this program fits a rewatch, a recommendation, or a one-time experience and give one reason.
Plan the next remote watch by choosing a completely different mood from tonight's program.
